content: pytest-asyncio is the focused, minimal, widely-adopted plugin for testing asyncio-only code (uses @pytest.mark.asyncio). AnyIO's pytest plugin (bundled with anyio, uses @pytest.mark.anyio) is a superset that also supports Trio backends; overkill unless the library targets multiple async backends. Since this project's storage protocol targets asyncio specifically (asyncpg/aiosqlite), pytest-asyncio is the right minimal choice; anyio only needed if trio support becomes a requirement.
